_comment:
ogbn-mag, seeds 0-3, to put the paper's strongest claim on more than one seed.

Seed 42 (campaigns/mag.json) returned ROC 0.5913 / PR 0.0102 against a published
field sitting at chance: DEMO 0.4967, ConsisGAD 0.4909, NSReg 0.4836, SpaceGNN
0.4626. That is the largest margin anywhere in the paper and the only result a
reviewer cannot answer with 'not SOTA on Photo', because it is a different
regime rather than a bigger number. At n=1 it is also the most dismissible
result in the paper - a single seed on a single graph, with no spread to quote.
Four more seeds turn it into a mean with a standard deviation and let the
rotation set carry a paired test against the published field.

Measured from the seed-42 shards rather than estimated: 5.5 h per rotation-job,
82 GPU-hours per seed, 11.83 GB peak allocated. Four seeds is 60 rotation-jobs
and ~330 GPU-hours; on the five free cards at three jobs each that is ~22 h
wall-clock. GPUs 0-2 are held by another user and are not in the pool.

Full 400-epoch protocol budget, matching seed 42 exactly - a shorter run scores
lower under best-over-epochs selection and would bias these seeds against the
one already measured, which is the direction that flatters our pre-registered
P5 ('OUTPOST stays below 0.60'). P5 is already close to the line at 0.5913, so
the budget must not move.
